xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
As of December 31, 2025, the Board of NBCC comprised three Functional Directors, two Government Nominee Directors and four Independent Directors. Further, the appointment of Directors is made by the Government of India through the Administrative Ministry (MoHUA); therefore, the appointment of the requisite Independent Directors, including a Woman Independent Director, is beyond the power of NBCC and is awaited.
Mr Saleem Ahmad, Director (Projects) was relieved from NBCC (India) Limited w.e.f. 23-12-2025. Accordingly, the Administrative Ministry entrusted the additional charge of the post of Director (Projects), NBCC(I) Limited to Sh K P Mahadevaswamy, Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD), NBCC(I) Ltd. for a period of three months w.e.f. from 23.12.2025 or till a regular incumbent joins the post or until further orders, whichever is earlier

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex: The matter is being pursued with the Administrative Ministry i.e. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to speed-up the process for the appointment of the requisite nos. of Independent Directors including a Woman Independent Director on the Board of NBCC in compliance to the applicable statutory provisions.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: The Stock Exchanges i.e. BSE and NSE, each has imposed on the Company a fine of Rs. 5,42,800 inclusive of GST@18% for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, levied during the quarter ended December 31, 2025, for Non compliance with the requirements pertaining to Regulation 17(1) composition of the Board including failure to appoint woman director within the period provided under this regulation of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015. The Company being the Government Company do not have power to appoint Directors on its own and the appointment of Directors on the Board of the Company is made by the Govt. of India through the Administrative Ministry i.e. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. Further, as per Para 3 i.e. Impossibility of Compliance of the uniform crave outs policy namely Policy for exemption of fines levied as per the provisions of SEBI SOP Circular, In case of any non-compliance arising out of inability of company to comply on account of any of the following reasons: a) Make any appointment to the Board of Directors / of KMPs due to pending approval for appointment of Directors / KMP etc., from the Government (Ministry)/ Regulator/ Any Statutory Authority.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Non-compliance with the requirements pertaining to the Regulation 17(1) composition of the Board including failure to appoint woman director.
